title: Custom Exceptions
description: Create and use custom exceptions for better error handling.

data.text: Custom domain exceptions make your code more expressive and let you map business rules to specific GraphQL error codes.
Define custom exception types for common domain errors like "not found," "validation failed," or "conflict."

data.title: Custom Exceptions

data.text: Use an exception filter or middleware to convert domain exceptions into structured GraphQL errors with codes and extensions.

data.title: Exception Filter
data.content: Map custom exceptions to error codes.

data.title: Reuse Across Services
data.text: Package your domain exceptions and exception filter as a shared library so all your GraphQL services handle errors consistently.

terms.definition: An exception that represents a business rule violation or domain-specific error.
A short string identifier that helps clients classify errors programmatically.
Additional metadata attached to a GraphQL error for client consumption.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Custom exceptions make business errors explicit
Exception filters map exceptions to error codes
data.takeaway: Next, we'll implement error logging and monitoring for production.
